nom: SUNDAY RILEY Pink Drink Firming Resurfacing Essence

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some describing psoriasis-related dryness, report increased softness, plumping and hydration, though one long-time dry-skin user found it instantly wicked moisture away and worsened tightness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation and even soothing, refreshing effects, while one with dry sensitive skin describes a severe moisture-stripping reaction and another with rosacea felt no effect at all.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to 70s report firming, softer lines and wrinkles, and a brighter, more youthful look, with one exception who saw no results and felt it suited older dry skin better than her own.
segments.combination: One reviewer with sensitive/combination skin reports improved texture, firmness and radiance with continued use.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers focused on aging report firmer skin and visibly reduced fine lines and wrinkles around the mouth; a few, however, say it is too early to tell or that they saw no visible anti-aging effect.
concerns.dehydration: The majority describe immediate hydration, plumping and softness lasting through the day; one reviewer with dry sensitive skin instead reports the product pulling moisture out of her face.
concerns.redness: A small number of reviewers say it helps balance redness or calmed psoriasis-related redness, with no reports of increased redness.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with psoriatic-arthritis related dry patches reports the skin looked less inflamed and less patchy after use, describing it as healing her damaged skin.
concerns.spots: Not enough reviewer comments specifically distinguish dark spots or pigmentation from general complexion improvement to draw a separate conclusion.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several reviewers say breakouts stopped or skin cleared up, but two others state the product broke them out.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the product contains no oils or butters, which she valued, but no reviewer explicitly reports a change in oil control.

aspects.libelle: Tightening or tingling feel after spraying
Small bottle empties quickly for the price
Spray pump misfires or hits eyes
No noticeable effect for some users
Helps other products absorb and layer better

extraits.texte: I have just discovered Sunday Riley and the first product I used was the Good Genes,love. The second was the CEO oil, like. The third was this Pink Drink, hate. Before you get upset let me explain. I am in my mid 60's and have always had dry sensitive skin. I'm not sure why this is so bad for my face but first I tried spraying it and it comes out strong and hits way off center so next I tried it by spraying in my hands and patting on my face but it just instantly soaks in and feels as if it just sucked out all my moisture with a vacuum. I thought I might need a little more but NO, same thing. I haven't ever had a reaction like this before. I was hoping it would work but by far the worst and weirdest reaction I have ever experienced. I will just continue to use my Avene water spray that doubles as my moisturizer. Hope your skin has a better outcome.

I bought this while it was sale for the beauty sale. it's feels great. doesn't really do anything though. doesn't have a smell. I use it mostly in the mornings after rinsing my face. I have sensitive, reactive skin and rosacea. didn't make break out.

I reviewed this in an Ipsy box who knows how long ago. I'm incredibly bad at opening them when they come in. But I finally opened it and sorted things out to try tonight in my skin care routine. I have psoriatic arthritis abs have patches on my face. As such my skin is fairly dry. I started with my cleanser and use the Pink Drink right afterward. I followed with vitamin c serum, illuminating serum, snail muscin and my moisturize followed by a warm massage to let it settle in and a cold massage to close my pores again. . I've been doing the other steps for about a month but this pink drink stuff is legit. Immediately afterwards my skin was softer, more hydrated, no patches of psoriasis and not red anymore. I am amazed. It's been about 6 hours and I still feel hydrated. It's going to become a vital step in my skin care routine and it's already healing my damaged skin. Definitely buy this!

Tried this on a whim and so happy I did. My face has never felt better. I use it twice daily immediately after cleansing. My skin feels hydrated, firm and bright. It also feels like its helping to control my acne because I'm normally blemish prone and I haven't had a single breakout since incorporating this in to my routine. Highly recommended.
It definitely works! I saw firmer, brighter looking skin. It has a great mist too. Unfortunately it did break me out as well.

I bought this on a whim not really knowing what it would do. Wow! It made an immediate difference in the lines and wrinkles in my face, particularly around my mouth. My husband kept commenting that my wrinkles were going away. I thought he was crazy until I did a side by side. I am very happy with this impulse purchase!

I received a sample size of Pink Drink Firming Resurfacing Essence with the Sunday Riley "Wake Up With Me" kit. It lives up to its name! It's easy to spritz on clean dry skin, and leaves my face feeling smooth and ready to apply any other products. I have sensitive skin and have had NO problems with this product - my face feels better every time I use it. I'm surprised and pleased with the improvements I'm seeing in my skin, and I've already invested in a full sized bottle.
